roi_summary: Baukjen can expect significant commercial benefits from implementing the full roadmap over 12 weeks. Phase 1 (weeks 1-4) delivers a 15% reduction in content-drafting time for marketing teams, while also generating 3-5x more reviews through automated post-purchase requests and reducing returns rates by capturing accurate reasons for returns. By week 8, the Size Guide Chatbot reduces size-related returns by up to 25%, and the WhatsApp Styling Assistant helps close sales with customers on WhatsApp. Finally, AI Demand Forecasting (week 12) reduces forecasting errors by 20-50% and cuts lost sales from stockouts.
